title: PBA: Tim Cone says Ginebra ‘killed’ by crucial call in Game 4
summary: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra coach Tim Cone is urging for better officiating after he felt his team fell on the wrong end of it…

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra coach Tim Cone is urging for better officiating after he felt his team fell on the wrong end of it during Friday’s Game 4 loss to San Miguel Beer that forced their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series to a decider. One call left Cone fuming late when Scottie Thompson was called for a foul while guarding George King, as the Gin Kings felt that the Beermen import should have been called for a traveling instead.
